19094.overview: The evil commander Borf has kidnapped Ace's girlfriend, the beautiful Kimberly, and is plotting to enslave the Earth using his dreaded "Infanto Ray", a weapon that changes everyone it blasts into a helpless baby. Armed with only a laser gun, Ace must find and destroy the Infanto Ray, rescue Kimberly and save the Earth. All in a day's work for a superhero, right? Featuring full screen animation and crisp, powerful sound from the original laser disc arcade classic, Space Ace delivers arcade action at its most addictive!

23031.overview:
This is the sequel to Kingdom: The Far Reaches. Many years ago, the wise Mobus broke a powerful amulet called "The Hand" in 5 pieces in order to protect it from getting into the hands of his evil brother Torlock. These pieces were sent to the far corners of the land. As the young Prince Lathan Kandor you have already retrieved the Black Mace, the Hunting Horn and the Orb of Mobus (in the previous game). Now you must retrieve the final 2 pieces (the Dagger of Arne and the Crown of Malric), defeat evil and be reunited with Princess Grace Delight.

This is an adventure from the makers of Dragon's Lair. The plot isn't exactly original or complex, but the animation is fluid and well-drawn. Gameplay is about using the right item or making the correct choice between the animated sequences; some of these choices are timed, meaning that you can lose health or even die, but there are plenty of opportunities to replenish your health. Of special note is the ever-present Disney-like music.

23070.overview:
Sargon Chess is a chess engine inspired by the Mesopotamian king Sargon that allows you to play a game of chess.

The game features 16 different difficulty levels. A special Novice level gives you starter tips and allows you to take back moves and changes sides. It is also possible to construct Chess challenges and let "Sargon" solve them.

The game can be played with 3 distinct chess sets which are displayed in a quasi-3D perspective.

23071.overview:
Scotland Yard Interactive is a digital version of the board game Scotland Yard by Ravensburger. Mr. X is London's most wanted criminal and it's up to the players to catch him.

In the game each turn players try to chase down Mr. X. Players have tokens for use of taxis, buses and the tube. But when the tokens run out the funding for the hunt is up and Mr. X. goes free. Mr. X. receives all used tokens and thus it becomes easier for him to travel throughout the game. But as a clue to the other players he must show which token he uses each turn. Mr. X. has a limited number of black tokens which could stand for any means of transportation. At five specific times during the game, Mr. X. has to reveal his current position. The detectives win when they land on the same square as Mr. X. Mr. X. wins when all tokens are spend up.

This digital conversion features photographs and digital animations of London. The game can be played with up to six players and both Mr. X. and the detectives can be A.I. controlled.

23072.overview: It's the 1950's. The place is the Indo-Chinese country of Opalia. Opalia has become the target of the USSR and the United States and its geographic position has made it a real hot spot in the Cold War battle of the superpowers. Networks of underground informants and foreign spies have totally destabilized this once peaceful country and local rebels, led by the devious Prime Minister, Vishaka, are trying to topple the king. The safety of Opalia is in your hands alone... you can't let them down!

23073.overview:
Shaolin's Road is a action adventure that takes place in medieval China. When Tsu Yu's father, a powerful warlord, is murdered and his sword stolen, Tsu Yu vows to avenge his father's murder. The player (as Tsu Yu) will have to learn Shaolin Kung Fu to do so. 

The player has to roam the land and speak with other Kung Fu heroes, who will most likely only scoff at the player. Occasionally they will send the player on a trial which comes in the form of a mini game, such as shooting a snake with a bow and arrow, engaging in Kung Fu fighting and karate, throwing stars, performing calligraphy and playing memory to learn Chinese symbols. 

Completing challenges changes the color of the player's belt and gives him more recognition with the other fighters allowing him to progress further. It also unlocks new pieces of the map you can use to travel to new areas.

23074.overview:
Solar Crusade is an on-rails FMV shoot 'em up designed and published by Infogrames Multimedia, created using Softimage 3D, and modeled on Silicon Graphics workstations hardware for the Windows 95 operating system and Phillips CD-i video game console.

It was the last game released for the Cd-i.

23075.overview: Space Ranger: Return to Earth is an action game, developed by Studio Interactive and published by Older Games, which was released in 2002.

23076.overview: Sport Freaks is a sports quiz game based on a Dutch television game show of the same name. The game includes all the questions that were written for the show but were never used. All the questions relate to a selection of 45 sports in 50 countries since the year 1900. The number of questions in the game (1250) equals 60 game show episodes. Using a sort of slot machine each turn a sport, year and country is chosen which you receive a question about. The emphasis lies on Dutch sports history.

23077.overview: Your mission is to destroy 6 enormous battle cruisers to save the planet. You have 15 days to destroy the ships before they reach your planet. If they do, the consequences will be disastrous. Your prototype ship has been developed and its name is "Steel Machine". You will have to find a way to destroy the main reactors of each battle cruiser, by destroying the main reactor the ship will destabilise causing the cruiser to blow up. The cruisers have lots of enemy defences to be destroyed. The game is a horizontal shoot'em-up based on the old Commodore 64 game Uridium by Andrew Braybrook. It is one of the first CDi game titles which fully uses the hardware. Controlling the Steel Machine is quite simple.

23078.overview: Striker Pro is a soccer game for the CD-i. The game has a top-down view with the goals at the top and bottom of the playing field. In the game you can choose from 64 national teams to play with. There are various game modes such as friendly, world league and world cup. Optionally the game can be played in a 6 vs 6 mode. The game can be played against the AI or another player.

23079.overview:
Surf City is an interactive musical with songs from the Beach Boys. 

In the game the player is presented with an overview map of the beach town aptly named Surf City. The player can click on various streets, which triggers a scene where the street scrolls by and the player can click on the various buildings he wants to visit. Inside the building the player can talk to people and interact with items. The scenes are accompanied with Beach Boys music from the 60s and help tell the story of the main characters of the game.

There's various games and activities to be played as well such as:
Build a hot rod
Go bowling at the Beach Bowl
Design a surfboard
Play the video jukebox
Race cars at the arcade speedway
Take a pizza order
Learn surf lingo from Tiki
Visit the love teller
Take a pop quiz at the high school
Watch fireworks on the pier
Order a burger-to-go
Play spin-the-bottle at Wendy's house

23145.overview:
Strip Poker Live is a strip poker game. There are six women to play against: a Swedish blonde, a Mediterranean brunette, a Maui, a Parisian and an athletic girl. 

Like most strip poker games you play poker against the AI and as you are winning the opponent will gradually lose pieces of clothing.

23146.overview: Strip-Poker Pro is a typical game of strip poker. You play the game of poker, but for each hand lost a player loses a piece of clothing. There are five computer opponents; three women and two men. Each of the computer opponents is displayed in full motion video.

23157.overview: Sandy's Circus Adventure is a children's title about a friendly sea lion called Sandy. Sandy is lost in the circus and together with the player she will explore it. Sandy can have fun with the clowns, be launched out of a giant cannon, disappear inside a magician's hat, juggle and much more circus related activities. Every activity is accompanied with cartoon animations and digital music and sound effects. Furthermore there are some more active and creative activities such as color drawings, creating short animations and creating clowns faces by making combinations of facial features.

23172.overview:
Now kids can practice basic math skills and help the Stickybear family out of some sticky jams at the same time. It's simple - for every set of addition and subtraction problems youngsters get right, Stickybear gets a step closer to getting out of a jam.

Get enough problems right and Stickybear gets out of one jam... but into another...

And kids practice skills at a pace that's just right for them... because Stickybear Math, the computer automatically advances when the child is ready to try another skill level. Adults can choose a child's starting level. So, horizontal or vertical problems, single-digit or four-digit, carrying or borrowing, kids are ready for them!

23173.overview: Stickybear: Preschool is an educational title for children ages three through six, based on Richard Hefter's Stickybear character. In this game players learn and improve basic skills such as recognizing shapes or opposites, learning the alphabet and counting and grouping items and colors. Each of the simple games is accompanied with cartoon animations and sound effects of Stickybear and his friends. The game is bilingual in English and Spanish.

23174.overview:
Stickybear: Reading is an educational title for children ages four to eight, based on Richard Hefter's Stickybear character. The game features three different reading activities, all accompanied with cartoon animations, music and comical sound effects.

Using the Sentence Builder players can create their own sentences from nouns and verbs, which will be read out loud by Stickybear. Each sentence features an animation. In Sarah's Word Book players can click on items which then animate, their names are said and displayed textually. Finally in Word Bop, players use a magical cannon that turns items into words and vice versa. The game features both the English and Spanish language to play in.

123745.overview: Super Mario's Wacky Worlds is a canceled Mario platform video game developed by NovaLogic for the Philips CD-i system. The game was conceived as a sequel to Super Mario World

135356.overview: Star Everyone loves stories with fair maidens, handsome princes, fiendish villains and fantastic settings. Here’s a great way to create stories of your very own, whether they’re fairy tales with happy endings or thrilling adventure stories. We’ve supplied all the tools you need to devise stories from scratch: dozens of scenes, hundreds of intersecting characters, a complete alpha numeric keyboard for narration & dialogue. even musical accompaniment to suit every plot twist!

139198.overview:
Soundtrap is an educational title about sound for children of 8 years and older. In this game children learn the principles, terms and practical applications of sound. The game is based on the educational children's books by Two-Can Publishing.

After a series of interactive lessons, the player can have a go at the main game: An adventure game in which the player has to apply his knew knowledge to the test.

194260.overview:
Shipwreck is an educational title about electricity and magnetism for children of 8 years and older. In this game children learn the principles, terms and practical applications of electricity. The game is based on the educational children's books by Two-Can Publishing.

In the main game the player is shipwrecked on an island and has to repair a broken motorboat in order to escape from the evil clutches of "Ohm". The player will have to put all his knowledge of electricity to good use to succeed.

194266.overview: Galaxis leads you into an intergalactic adventure that you design yourself. On this journey it is up to your imagination whether your stories are strange, ghostly or funny.

215592.overview:
Stickybear: Family Fun - Games is a children's title based on Richard Hefter's Stickybear character. Unlike other Stickybear licensees which are more educative in character this game is all about having fun.

The game offers a variety of mini-games such as Hangman, Tic Tac Toe and Hippity Hop, a peg jumping game. All the games are accompanied with familiar Stickybear characters which are fully animated and accompanied with amusing sound effects.

420498.overview:
Santa Claus' Mice is an audiobook with activities and games for children of ages 3 to 7. The story is about a mouse who works for Santa Claus. The text can be displayed while it is pronounced for early readers to learn the words.

Aside from the story itself, there's also games to be played. Parents can select games of an appropriate age level for their children. There are five games to be played, but they are all pretty much similar. In each game, a series of questions is asked. The player can click on a picture which represents a scene, person, animal or item from the game to select his or her answer. Some questions are about the content of the game. Others ask for the opinion of the player (for example: "During which part of the story would you have been most frightened if you were the main character?") There's no wrong answer in these cases.

The game is part of the Storybook Adventures series and features the exact same interface as the other titles in the series: a magic bookmark that turns into a wizard as your guide.
